title: 'GOLDEN HOUR : Part.6' showcases ATEEZ's musical identity
summary: ATEEZ has released its 15th extended play (EP), 'GOLDEN HOUR : Part.6,' a record that showcases the diverse musical styles that have come to define the K-pop powerhouse's sound.
